english.title: Cause / permit taxi to be available for hire or load passengers without written authorisation
english.standardoffencewording:
On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..)

(A)_[caused]_
(B)_[permitted]_

a Taxi, namely **(..SPECIFY VEHICLE MAKE AND INDEX NUMBER..), to be available for hire or loading of passengers,

(C)_[without written permission from Bristol Airport Limited]_
(D)_[on a part of Bristol Airport not designated as an Authorised Taxi Stand, namely **(..SPECIFY LOCATION..)]_

english.legislation: Contrary to byelaws 7.1 and 3.4 of the Bristol Airport Byelaws 2012 and sections 63 and 64 of the Airports Act 1986.
